title: S09T01 - Define MCP resource boundary and project-root guard
description: Document exactly what resources/tools MCP may expose and how each request binds to one Boreal workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: No MCP call can read another registered project unless explicitly selected.
Memory root, project root, and workspace root are validated per request.
closedReason: Implemented and documented the MCP resource boundary/project-root guard, with tests for selected-project binding and unselected project path rejection.
